maarif-sablon.name: Template Studio
maarif-sablon.description: Turn everyday announcements into consistent, ready to export designs.

Each Download JPG action produced a readable JPEG with nonzero dimensions, with no broken browser images or download failures. The recording shows the original selection, editing and preview workflow.
maarif-sablon.role: Solo creator · Product, design and engineering
maarif-sablon.ownership: I designed and built this project independently, including its interface and implementation.
maarif-sablon.problem: Routine institutional announcements share a visual system but carry different names, dates and contact details. Recreating each layout manually makes consistency harder to maintain.
maarif-sablon.contribution: I designed and built the template collection, editing forms, live previews and image export, including the layout rules for each announcement type.
maarif-sablon.implementation: Typed template data feeds React layouts. The editor measures the available space to scale its preview, while export uses the original canvas dimensions and embedded fonts.
maarif-sablon.result: A user can choose a template, enter the announcement details and export a JPG. Seven template routes cover appointment, departure, HR information, condolences and celebrations.

dsh-studio.problem: Working with a coding agent involves more than sending a prompt. Sessions, streamed output, tool approvals and model settings need to stay understandable as work progresses.
